definitions.explanation: Japan's best-known flea-market app, launched in 2013, on which individuals buy and sell used goods.

examples.english: I sold some clothes on Mercari.

examples.japanese: ⟦いらない→いる：00495_iru⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧メルカリ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出品|しゅっぴん}→出品：11726_shuppin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I listed the books I didn't need on Mercari.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{使|つか}わなく→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧メルカリ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}って→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧にした。
examples.english: Before moving, I sold the furniture I no longer used on Mercari and turned it into cash.

notes:
The name is used almost like a common noun for selling one's things online.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- メルカリ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧ / ⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to sell / buy on Mercari
- メルカリ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出品|しゅっぴん}→出品：11726_shuppin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to list an item on Mercari
- メルカリ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}れた→売れる：02012_ureru⟧: it sold on Mercari

RELATED WORDS:
- フリマ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: flea-market app (the general term)
- ⟦{出品|しゅっぴん}→出品：11726_shuppin⟧: listing an item for sale
